note:
USACE campground on Carlyle Lake.  Multiple RV sites directly on the shoreline.  --AWH
The shoreline sites are the outer ring of the Loop 1 point (about 12-30), on open lawn above a riprap bank; the Loop 5 sites along the west shore sit under trees. Swimming beach with its own showers in the adjoining day-use area. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov record, rates, catalog and calendar read: USACE-run, 145 reservable electric sites (50 A; full hookups at 26 L1 sites), $20 (2026, 2027), all reservable incl. same day, 14 in 30; showers, flush toilets, dump. Groups written manual. Lakefront (--AWH) confirmed on imagery at the L1 point sites. Pin ~440 m off the site centroid: move recommended. Phone missing: add 618-226-3211.
flags: WATERFRONT (--AWH lakefront; not changed): agrees. Esri imagery (0.29 m/px) with the catalog points: the L1 peninsula's outer back-in sites 016, 018, 019, 020, 021, 022, 023, 024, 026, 028, 030 (and 012/014 on the north cove) face out over open mowed lawn to a riprap-lined shore, no road between: measured pad to water ~12-32 m (021 at 38.65680,-89.26422 ~32 m; 022 ~25 m; 023 ~19 m; 024 ~18 m; 026 ~25 m; 028 ~19 m; 030 ~20 m). 3DEP: site 021 137.7 m, 024 137.8 m vs water 135.3 m (pool 135.6 m): ~2 m above pool, not a bluff. All are nightly reservable sites. Loop 5's west sites (121-137) are ~29 m from the water but under canopy across a sand/riprap band: view-ish. Caveat proposal in the note (riprap bank).

PIN: stored 38.6569,-89.2603 is ~440 m ENE of the 145-site centroid; move to 38.65428,-89.26412 (centroid; L1 centroid 38.65676,-89.26267, L5 38.65233,-89.26575). The catalog plots site 001 alone at 38.657402,-89.258988 by a pond east of the loops (odd point; excluded from nothing, it moves the centroid <10 m).

PHONE: none stored -> 618-226-3211 (recreation.gov facility phone). recreation.gov Contact Info also gives (618) 228-2197 staffed season and (618) 594-2484 off-season (Carlyle Lake office). WEBSITE: keep https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233463.
